verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for a payment platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only future-dated scheduled payments (a time-based action set in advance) and email notifications for tracking. Neither is a user-defined rule that fires an action automatically when an event occurs, and no rule engine or trigger mechanism is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
